main_body: Gong frame: two reddish-brown wooden posts with a top crossbeam and two foot blocks, holding a large round yellow gong disc between them. The gong is a vertical disc seen face-on.
top_band: Crossbeam at rows 2-3 (about 2 rows, light pinkish-brown #b57b62 / #955944), then a dark underside at rows 4-5. This is a thin cap and rim, not a surface. The posts and feet show no top faces.
evidence: The frame is drawn straight from the front. The crossbeam is a 1-2 row light line over a dark band of the same width, which is the red 'flat band cap' / rim-only case. The posts are plain vertical strips with no visible top faces. The foot blocks at rows 29-31 are only 2-3 rows of the same tone with no distinct top surface. The gong is a face-on disc. The contract requires the horizontal beam and base to show top faces, and they do not.

style.evidence: The gong has about 5 yellow steps with a highlight and a dished centre, and the wood has 3-4 reddish-brown steps. The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral edge pixels). There are no flat 5x5 fills, and 11 colours per tile is reasonable. It is lower than the references (17 and 20 colours per tile, 18 distinct colours against 38-40) and the posts are fairly plain strips with little wood grain. Overall it is a bit thinner than the references but acceptable.
